parsed.why: Explicit criminal statute targeting trans feminine presentation with documented arrests, anal examinations, gathering bans and rising capital violence; judicial pushback is partial and border/facility practice undocumented.

Trans-inclusive hate-speech and discrimination law, self-ID, liberal society and a maximum sentence for the Pride shooting; offset by rising reports, 8% reporting rate, falling clearance and concentrated organised hostility.

No trans-specific offence or documented targeting, and one accepted third-gender territory; but majority social hostility, religious institutional opposition, no discrimination or hate-crime recourse, and stalled reforms leave thin protection.

X markers on passports, criminalised transphobia, preference-based custody protocol and courts awarding damages against refusals; residual documented street crime and uneven prison practice keep it below the top band.

Sodomy law still usable as a documented police extortion lever, justice failure against a stabbed trans woman, and 69 violence cases prompting regional censure; offset by the struck-down cross-dressing ban and 72% acceptance.
